rootCause: The mandatory Base Runtime contains a disconnected registry type: it neither publishes the registry to Spring nor invokes it from lexical context bind/restore/clear. Observability consequently cannot start, and a bean-only fix would still leave MDC/trace projection non-functional.
requiredFix: One Base-owned classloader-scoped runtime registry exposed as an overridable Spring bean
Projection on lexical bind, parent restoration on nested close, clear on final close and close-order violation
Observability projection lifecycle unregisters from the shared registry
Targeted Java 25 tests plus Fresh Generated runtime replay
